title: Analysis of the dynamics of ophthalmological emergencies at a university hospital
summary:
Background: Background: University hospitals serve as tertiary care centers and provide care for a broad spectrum of acutely ill patients from the entire catchment area. In addition to primary emergency presentations, a substantial proportion of patients are referred from outpatient specialist practices to the university hospital for further diagnostic evaluation. This specific care structure results in a high and heterogeneous utilization of emergency departments.
Research question:the aim of this study is to analyze the spectrum of treated emergency cases and to compare emergency presentations between different hospitals in order to identify potential trends and influencing factors.
Methods:All patients were pseudonymized and categorized, and the collected data were analyzed according to the type of emergency conditions treated at the clinic
conditions: Ophthalmologic emergencies in patients of all age groups.

interventions.name: All patients of all age groups and sexes who presented as emergencies at Hannover Medical School (MHH) between 2014 and 2024 and whose data were collected retrospectively

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients of different ages and sexes who presented to the Department of Ophthalmology at Hannover Medical School (MHH) for emergency care between early 2014 and the end of 2024.
Exclusion criteria:
none
